title: Month close policy
description: Financial month close of a plant (SME R1 / R4, EXPERT_REVIEW phase R-B): the calendar of the financial month, the weekend days of the close calendar (holidays come from the plant calendar), the working-day deadlines after month end for the quantity close (plant management) and the finance sign-off, whether open change proposals block the close, and the optional materiality routing (an extra reviewer before finance when the month's adjustments reach a threshold per unit of measure). Tenant-wide; seeded per plant on first use (Iranian plants: Solar Hijri months and a Thursday-Friday weekend). Consumed by `src/close/month-close.service.ts`.

financialCalendar.description: Calendar of the financial month: Gregorian calendar months, or Solar Hijri (Jalali) months.

weekendDays.description: ISO weekdays (1 = Monday ... 7 = Sunday) that are not working days of the close calendar.

quantitiesCloseWorkingDay.description: Plant management closes the month's quantities by this working day after month end (SME R4 pilot: 3).

financeSignOffWorkingDay.description: Finance signs the month off by this working day after month end (SME R4 pilot: 5); not before the quantity close.

blockOnOpenProposals.description: An open change proposal of the month blocks the close until it is accepted or dismissed.

requireCertifiedDays.description: Owner decision 14 Oct 2026 (SME R2): every production day of every unit must be certified before the quantity close. Absent in a version written before the option = false.

thresholds.description: Unit of measure -> quantity of |bridge + classified Unaccounted + tolerance adjustment| at or above which the month needs the extra review.

reviewerRoles.description: Scope roles that may give the extra review (independent of both signers).
